# Midman মিডম্যান

Midman (মিডম্যান) is Bangladesh's leading escrow service and P2P transaction platform. Built with Next.js.

## Pages

- [Home](https://midman.bd/) - Escrow service landing page with features, pricing, and reviews
- [How It Works](https://midman.bd/how-it-works) - Step-by-step escrow process guide
- [Fees](https://midman.bd/fees) - Escrow fee structure and pricing
- [Security](https://midman.bd/security) - Security measures and data protection
- [FAQ](https://midman.bd/faq) - Frequently asked questions about escrow and P2P transactions
- [About](https://midman.bd/about) - About Midman escrow service
- [Contact](https://midman.bd/contact) - Contact information
- [Privacy Policy](https://midman.bd/privacy) - Privacy policy
- [Terms & Conditions](https://midman.bd/terms) - Terms of service
- [Blog](https://midman.bd/blog) - Blog and updates

## Features

- Escrow service for safe online transactions in Bangladesh
- P2P (peer-to-peer) transaction support
- bKash, Nagad, Rocket payment support
- Buyer and seller protection
- Deal tracking and real-time updates
- Admin dashboard for dispute resolution
- Refund and payout management
- AI-powered customer support
- User reviews and feedback system
- Affiliate program
- Responsive design with dark mode support
